title: PrivateLM Persona Schema
description: Schema for importing and exporting AI personas in PrivateLM (v1.0).

persona_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID or slug) for the persona.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the persona.

aliases.description: Optional alternative names or handles for this persona.

system_prompt.description: System instruction injected ahead of conversation history for local and cloud inference.

greeting.description: Optional opening line displayed in the empty-chat state when this persona is active.

avatar_path.description: Optional local file path or asset reference for the persona avatar.

few_shot_examples.description: Example user/assistant turns injected between the system prompt and live conversation history.

generation_settings.description: Optional per-persona generation parameter overrides. Null or omitted fields fall back to global app settings.

stop.description: Additional stop sequences merged with global stop sequences.

metadata.description: Arbitrary source/provenance metadata (e.g. source, created_at, updated_at) preserved across import/export round-trips.
